2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch updates the ZSTD_initStaticCCtx function to use the ZSTD_cpuSupportsBmi2 helper, which checks for both BMI1 and BMI2 support on x86 CPUs. This ensures that the function behaves correctly even if only one of these instructions is supported. The change has no functional impact on any existing CPU in the field.
